title: EXEC CICS WEB PARSE URL: scheme, host, port, path and query string of a URL (default ports, IPv4 / IPv6 hosts), INVREQ for an incorrect URL or bad escape, LENGERR for a short output buffer

scenarios.summary: Five well-formed URLs: scheme returned upper case, explicit and default ports (80 / 443), a dotted IPv4 host, an IPv6 host without its brackets
A URL with no scheme is INVREQ RESP2 28; a bad percent escape is INVREQ RESP2 65
One output buffer too short per command: HOSTLENGTH 4 is LENGERR RESP2 29, PATHLENGTH 1 is 30, QUERYSTRLEN 1 is 8
